apps.description: A free, open-source media library for Android TV. Bring your own sources and Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings and subtitles.

signers.label: NuvioTV release key (CN=NuvioTV, O=NuvioTV)
signers.note: Measured with apksigner on official GitHub release assets 0.9.5-beta and 1.0.0; unchanged across both.

trust.review: Pinned from the publisher's own GitHub release assets on 2026-10-12. Confirm out-of-band with the publisher before relying on it, and re-verify with scripts/measure-apk.sh before changing.

steps: Open the official Nuvio TV releases page on another device.
Download the APK that matches your device (arm64-v8a for most newer devices, armeabi-v7a for older ones).
Transfer it to your TV and install it with a file manager.

apps.description: An IPTV player for Android TV. It includes no channels or playlists; you add your own legal sources.

trust.review: NO REVIEWED CERTIFICATE YET. iMPlayer's official download is https://implayer.tv/d (from some networks it answers non-browser clients with a Cloudflare browser check; from a GitHub Actions runner on 2026-10-12 it redirected to the vendor's own storage bucket and served a ~98 MB universal APK: package com.myiptvonline.implayer, version 4.1.6, versionCode 486, minSdk 23, signing certificate SHA-256 e1cacb9974064e78d6aefe2d78b5eea6f30592887589a1254648749973d7d766). That is a single sample obtained from the same channel as the file, with no independently published fingerprint to corroborate it, so it is NOT pinned. Until a maintainer confirms it out-of-band and adds it under trust.signers, this app is never installed automatically; the guided route is used instead. The Downloader code 82375 shown in the guide was supplied by the project owner; this build does not vouch for what it resolves to.

steps: Install "Downloader" by AFTVnews from the Amazon Appstore.
Open Downloader and enter the code 82375.
Let the download finish, then choose Install when prompted.
Return to TV Essentials. iMPlayer will show as installed.

signers.label: SmartTube release key, issued 2025-11-27 (CN=Yurii L, O=SmartTube)
signers.note: Post-incident key. Measured with apksigner on official release assets 31.94s, 32.56s and 32.56 (stable and beta share it).

trust.review: The maintainer disclosed a compromised development environment and possible signing-key exposure and rotated to this certificate (created 2025-11-27). Pinned from the project's own GitHub release assets on 2026-10-12. The pre-rotation fingerprint was never published and its release assets are gone, so it cannot be listed under 'revoked'; it is rejected anyway because only the pinned certificate is trusted and lineage rotation is disabled. Confirm this fingerprint out-of-band before relying on it.

steps: Install "Downloader" by AFTVnews from the Amazon Appstore.
Open Downloader and enter the code 28544 (stable) or 79015 (beta).
Let the download finish, then choose Install when prompted.
